findings.title: `pump_target_healthy` is set to 1 and never cleared, so the trap guard it documents is inert
`libexec/orchid-run`'s boundary-record schema comment omits the `counters` field that same arm writes

summary: Both halves of the finding are fixed at the mechanism rather than in prose, with shared predicates and non-vacuous RED/GREEN coverage; the three remaining items are cosmetic or self-correcting and non
